batch.description: HSTU D Unit (Engineering, Science group) MCQ question bank, academic session 2014-2015 (Satt Academy year label 2014; D Unit exam dated 05 Nov 2014 per task-supplied bangladeshresult.com mapping), transcribed 2026-10-31 from the publicly readable first page of each Satt Academy subject section (Physics 15 of 25, Chemistry 15 of 25, Higher Mathematics 15 of 25, English 15 of 24; page 2 of each subject section is login-gated on Satt Academy and was not fetched). 59 of the 60 publicly readable cards are included; 1 card was excluded as incomplete in the source itself (see source document notes). Answers are Satt Academy's own marked answers (reading-mode correct marker cross-checked against the card's test-mode hidden answer field; all agreed). Content is not cross-source verified. [UNVERIFIED import-format edition: only the questions that did NOT pass cross-source verification, with true statuses preserved; see Admission-Unverified-Import/README.md.]

sourceDocuments.title: HSTU D Unit 2014 MCQ Question Bank & Solution (Satt Academy)
sourceDocuments.notes: HTML question bank at https://sattacademy.com/d-%E0%A6%87%E0%A6%89%E0%A6%A8%E0%A6%BF%E0%A6%9F-79/all/mcq-questions , retrieved 2026-10-31; local copy sources/pages/satt-hstu-d-2014-15-p1.html (sha256 is of that 'all' page, which server-renders the first 15 Physics cards). Per-subject first-page HTML retrieved the same day from the site's own subject endpoints is stored in sources/pages/ as satt-hstu-d-2014-15-physics.html, satt-hstu-d-2014-15-chemistry.html, satt-hstu-d-2014-15-math.html, satt-hstu-d-2014-15-english.html (15 cards each). Page 2 of each subject section returns {need_login:true} ('Login to continue') and was NOT fetched or bypassed, so 39 of the advertised 99 questions are not in this pack (Physics 10, Chemistry 10, Higher Mathematics 10, English 9). Satt's auto-generated Biology page for this exam is empty (D Unit has no Biology) and was ignored. MathML formulas are transcribed in a linear text form (e.g. 10^9, (a)/(b), ^40_20Ca for prescript isotope notation). Excluded as incomplete in the source itself: Higher Mathematics #12 — the card asks for the polar form of a complex number but no complex number appears anywhere in the card. Source anomalies preserved verbatim include: Chemistry formulas printed with 'CI' for Cl (e.g. PCI_5, NaCI) and azimuthal quantum number printed as '1 (এক)'; Physics #14 vector printed as (7i^ -6i^ +5k^) with i repeated in the source MathML; Higher Mathematics #5 options a/b both '49' and #10 options a/c/d all 'k = -2' in the source; Higher Mathematics #6 statement printed 'Z_1 + 2 + i' in the source. No independent second source was provided for this paper, so content is unverified.
